import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (colored by Sleep Disorder)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for disorder in data['Sleep Disorder'].unique():
    if pd.isna(disorder):
        mask = data['Sleep Disorder'].isna()
        label = 'No Disorder'
    else:
        mask = data['Sleep Disorder'] == disorder
        label = disorder
    ax1.scatter(data[mask]['Sleep Duration'], data[mask]['Quality of Sleep'], 
                alpha=0.6, s=100, label=label)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(data['Age'], bins=15, color=colors[0], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. BMI Category distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(range(len(bmi_counts)), bmi_counts.values, color=colors[1:len(bmi_counts)+1], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(bmi_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(bmi_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
scatter = ax4.scatter(data['Physical Activity Level'], data['Stress Level'], 
                     c=data['Sleep Duration'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress\n(colored by Sleep Duration)', fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax4, label='Sleep Duration')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
occupation_steps = data.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
ax5.barh(range(len(occupation_steps)), occupation_steps.values, color=colors[2], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_steps)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(occupation_steps.index, fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Average Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Average Daily Steps by Occupation', fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 6. Heart Rate distribution by Gender
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
gender_data = [data[data['Gender'] == g]['Heart Rate'].values for g in data['Gender'].unique()]
ax6.boxplot(gender_data, labels=data['Gender'].unique(), patch_artist=True,
            boxprops=dict(facecolor=colors[3], alpha=0.7),
            medianprops=dict(color='red', linewidth=2))
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Sleep Disorder distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
disorder_counts = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax7.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors[:len(disorder_counts)])
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax7.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontweight='bold')

# 8. Correlation heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = data[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numeric Variables', fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax8.set_xticklabels(ax8.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax8.set_yticklabels(ax8.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=9)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset - Comprehensive Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
